newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil cuts Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil cuts Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said Wednesday it lowered the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$5.00/cubic metre or C$0.79/barrel, to C$171.00/cubic metre or C$27.19/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:

Cromer light sour C$160.00/cubic metre, or C$25.44/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$128.00/cubic metre, or C$20.35/barrel Midale at Cromer C$144.00/cubic metre, or C$22.89/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
